name: qlrisk_sensitivities
title: Sensitivities and Greeks
description: Bump-and-reprice sensitivities for a book: DV01 (rates, per 1bp), CS01 (credit spreads, per 1bp), DIV01, equity/FX/commodity delta, vega, gamma (second order with central bumps), 1-day theta, key-rate ladders on native pillars or FRTB vertices, and optional cross-gamma between named factors. Results by risk class and measure, by trade, and by risk factor. Example: {"trades": [{"product": "InterestRateSwap", "notional": 10000000, "tenor_years": 5, "fixed_rate": 0.044}], "ladder_vertices": "frtb_girr"} gives the swap's DV01 and its SOFR/discount ladders.
